rules: This workspace holds one person’s settings, work documents and group memberships.
List memberships under user_config.groups in adk.json. Link a group ADK on the same device using a relative groups/<group> symlink.
Keep personal contact, account and device details and secrets out of source control. Store keys only in the git-ignored keys/ directory.
Keep personal work documents in docs/work/ and group work in the group ADK’s docs/work/.
Keep data, memory, channels and keys separate for each group.

Before starting work assigned on a messenger, reply to the original in the requester’s language, mention them, and state the task and an ETA. Report the result in the same thread and keep unfinished work open.
